2607.29093.title: metasignal: A Python Package for Comprehensive Metacognitive Analysis and Decision-Making
2607.29093.paper_summary: Metasignal is an open-source Python package for signal detection theory (SDT) and metacognitive measurement. It implements the 17 metacognitive measures evaluated by Rahnev (2025), together with the reference variables d' (perceptual sensitivity), response criterion c (response bias), and mean confidence. The 17 measures comprise three meta-d' family estimates, meta-d', M-ratio, and M-difference; four nonparametric Type-2 measures, the Type-2 area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC2), Gamma, Phi, and delta confidence, together with their eight SDT-normalized ratio and difference forms; and two model-based measures, meta-noise and meta-uncertainty. A single function computes the complete set from trial-level stimulus, response, and confidence arrays. `metasignal` currently supports binary (two-alternative) discrimination tasks, in which each trial's stimulus and response are coded with exactly two categories. The package also provides a command-line interface, group summaries, bootstrap confidence intervals, permutation tests, optional hierarchical Bayesian models, and information-theoretic measures. `metasignal` unifies these measures in a single platform to encourage broader metacognition research and adoption in decision-making studies.
2607.29093.paper_summary_zh: Metasignal 是一個開源的 Python 套件，用於信號檢測理論 (SDT) 和後設認知測量。<lb/>它實現了 Rahnev (2025) 評估的 17 種後設認知測量，並包含參考變數 d'（感知敏感性）、反應標準 c（反應偏差）和平均信心。<lb/>這 17 種測量包括三個 meta-d' 家族估計，meta-d'、M-ratio 和 M-difference；四個非參數的 Type-2 測量，即接收者操作特徵曲線下的 Type-2 面積 (AUC2)、Gamma、Phi 和 delta 信心，以及它們的八種 SDT 正規化比率和差異形式；還有兩個基於模型的測量，meta-noise 和 meta-uncertainty。<lb/>一個單一的函數從試驗級別的刺激、反應和信心數組計算完整的集合。<lb/>`metasignal` 目前支持二元（兩選一）辨別任務，其中每個試驗的刺激和反應都用恰好兩個類別編碼。<lb/>該套件還提供命令行介面、群組摘要、自助法信心區間、置換測試、可選的層級貝葉斯模型和信息理論測量。<lb/>`metasignal` 將這些測量統一在一個平台上，以促進更廣泛的後設認知研究和在決策研究中的應用。
